parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is a sliding glass panel of the window, framed with aluminum for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open and close horizontally, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along the track within the window frame.

parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the second sliding glass panel of the window, also framed with aluminum.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the complementary sliding section, enabling the window to open from either side.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally in the opposite direction of the first translation part.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the fixed frame of the window, made of aluminum, providing structural integrity.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and guides the sliding panels, ensuring smooth operation and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during window operation.
